cards.title: FLOOR RUNNER
cards.concept: trading-floor runner in a grey rain jacket with a numbered trader badge on the lapel and a cheap earpiece, a cracked hand tablet showing one simple rising line held at his chest
cards.hook: his career started in stockbroking, working the floor before he ever worked a deal room

cards.title: RACK HAND
cards.concept: night-shift data-hall rack hand in a grey utility vest over a dark tee, a keycard lanyard round his neck and a server drive caddy held at his chest
cards.hook: Country Business Manager at Digital Realty UK: he knows data centres from the rack up

cards.title: GPU HAWKER
cards.concept: night-market hawker in a grey hoodie with the hood down and a worn utility apron, a tray of chunky graphics cards held at his chest with one tiny cyan LED on the best one
cards.hook: born salesman now selling GPU compute: the best deal on the block, every time

cards.title: COLD CALLER
cards.concept: easy-grinning sales-floor caller in a grey bomber jacket, a boom-mic headset at one ear and a scuffed smartphone showing a call timer held up by his chest
cards.hook: started out in sales: dialling, pitching and never taking the first no

cards.title: SMOOTH OPERATOR
cards.concept: suave neon-district dealmaker in a sharp dark grey suit with an open collar, one tiny cyan LED cufflink, a plain business card held between two fingers at his chest and a knowing half-smile
cards.hook: the suave, smooth vibe and dark suit from his photo

cards.title: DATA BROKER
cards.concept: data broker in a dark trench coat with green-lit lining and a small temple implant, a slim cyberdeck tucked under one arm and a glowing green data chip between his fingers
cards.hook: growth and partnerships: brokering who connects with whom across the compute world

cards.title: DRONE JOCKEY
cards.concept: drone jockey in grey techwear with green terminal piping and a wrist controller, a small quad drone hovering behind his shoulder carrying a single GPU crate with cyan running lights
cards.hook: Director of Sales & Partnerships at a company that tokenises GPUs: he gets the hardware where it needs to go

cards.title: PACKET RUNNER
cards.concept: netrunner in a green-trimmed techwear jacket, a data cable running from a small implant on the back of his hand into a compact router-shaped cyberdeck with cyan port lights held at his chest
cards.hook: his Cisco and IBM work at Accenture UK: he knows where every packet goes

cards.title: GROWTH HACKER
cards.concept: growth strategist in a sharp dark techwear blazer with green code-stripe lapels, a slim wrist display projecting one bold green upward arrow beside his shoulder
cards.hook: growth and partnerships at Digital Realty UK: he hacks the growth curve straight up

cards.title: NEON FIXER
cards.concept: elite fixer in a sleek black long coat with glowing teal seams over a dark suit, a glowing cyan holographic contract card held up between two fingers by his chest
cards.hook: Director of Sales & Partnerships: the fixer who makes the big deals happen

cards.title: DATA HALL SAMURAI
cards.concept: street samurai in a sleek armoured jacket with glowing teal seams, the hilt of a cyan-glowing holo-katana rising behind his shoulder, standing guard
cards.hook: Digital Realty UK: sworn guardian of the halls where the compute lives

cards.title: THE CLOSER
cards.concept: elite closer in a high-collared black flight jacket over a dark turtleneck, no suit, thin teal light strips on the collar, his right hand in a chrome GPU gauntlet with cooling fins, fist raised by his chest with a faint cyan glow
cards.hook: he signs the GPU owners whose hardware his company tokenises into on-chain assets

cards.title: CHROME TYCOON
cards.concept: chrome-augmented corpo tycoon with polished chrome shoulder plates over a dark suit with magenta neon pinstripes, large violet holographic panels of simple rising bar charts floating behind both shoulders
cards.hook: from the stockbroking floor to selling GPU compute as a whole new asset class

cards.title: THE CONNECTOR
cards.concept: augmented legend in ornate chrome shoulder armour, glowing violet and hot-pink fibre-optic cables fanning out behind his back like wings into a constellation of neon network nodes
cards.hook: a career in growth, networks and partnerships: every connection runs through him

cards.title: MIDAS OF COMPUTE
cards.concept: ascended dealmaker in tailored white-and-gold chrome suit-armour, a halo of glowing golden GPU cores ringing high behind his head, a radiant gold token coin with a chip emblem held at his chest, a blazing golden aura around his silhouette
cards.hook: stockbroker, data-centre builder and GPU dealmaker in one: every GPU he touches turns into a golden on-chain asset
